drafter.private_reasoning: Protect the client's confidential reservation point. Use an opening proposal above that point, expressly subject to client approval. Any referral relationship must not influence the client's settlement terms. Clarify payment timing and limit the release to the dispute being settled.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial proposed revisions, subject to client review and approval. We propose a Settlement Amount of USD 6,000,000, payable within ten business days after execution, with the release effective only upon receipt of cleared funds. We have also clarified the release scope and customary confidentiality exceptions. Please provide your client's response; no binding settlement exists until a definitive agreement is executed by both parties.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Any withholding shall be limited to amounts required by applicable law, and Defendant shall provide documentation of amounts withheld and remitted. The Settlement Amount remains subject to Plaintiff's approval before execution.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, less any legally required withholding duly remitted, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims existing as of the date of execution arising out of the dispute described in the Recitals. This release excludes claims to enforce this Agreement, claims arising after execution, and rights or claims that cannot lawfully be waived. The parties shall identify the underlying dispute with specificity before execution.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures necessary to enforce this Agreement; and disclosures required by law or legal process. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to, communications with, or participation in proceedings before a governmental or regulatory authority, or any disclosure protected by applicable law.
